mentions.name: Agent Witness
mentions.description: A PWA that acts as a remote ssh-agent. Private keys are wrapped, encrypted, and stored locally in the phone's IndexedDB; the vault can only be unwrapped with a secret derived from a passkey, and all key handling and signing happens locally through the browser's Web Crypto APIs as non-extractable CryptoKey objects. Incoming signing requests arrive as push notifications showing the agent-supplied reason, the command being run, and the key requested; after passkey authorization the PWA signs the request and only the resulting signature is returned, so the private key never leaves the phone.
mentions.problem: Authorizing an AI agent's SSH signature requests remotely without private keys ever leaving the phone.
mentions.source_excerpt: Agent Witness runs as a PWA and is essentially a remote ssh-agent. The private keys are wrapped, encrypted, and stored in IndexedDB locally on the phone. The vault can only be unwrapped with a secret derived from a passkey, and all key handling and signing happens locally through the browser's Web Crypto APIs.
